# `browser-tab screenshot`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab screenshot [FLAGS] <id>`

Capture a tab or window as a jpeg (needs the daemon + extension for tabs)

## Arguments

### `<id>`

## Flags

### `--window`

Treat <id> as a window handle: tier 2 screencapture (opt-in)

### `--focus`

Tier 'tab': activate the tab first if it isn't active (changes user state)

### `--force`

Bypass the navEpoch shot cache and recapture

### `--out <file>`

Copy the captured jpeg to this path
